title: post api token obtain jwt tokens
description: Test the POST /api/token/ endpoint with valid and invalid credentials to verify correct issuance of JWT access and refresh tokens and proper error handling for invalid credentials.

title: post api token refresh refresh jwt access token
description: Test the POST /api/token/refresh/ endpoint with valid and invalid refresh tokens to verify correct issuance of new access tokens and proper error handling for invalid tokens.

title: post api token verify verify jwt token validity
description: Test the POST /api/token/verify/ endpoint with valid and tampered JWT tokens to verify token validity checking and appropriate error responses.

title: get accounts login session login page
description: Test the GET /accounts/login/ endpoint to verify that the login page is served correctly without authentication.

title: get accounts logout logout and redirect
description: Test the GET /accounts/logout/ endpoint with an active session to verify that the user is logged out and redirected to the login page.

title: post production orders create submit new production order
description: Test the POST /production/orders/create/ endpoint with valid and invalid request bodies to verify creation of production orders and validation error handling.

title: post production orders id start start production order
description: Test the POST /production/orders/{id}/start/ endpoint to verify that a production order transitions from Pending to In Progress state and redirects correctly.

title: post production orders id complete complete production order and update inventory
description: Test the POST /production/orders/{id}/complete/ endpoint to verify that a production order transitions from In Progress to Completed state, updates inventory accordingly, and redirects correctly.

title: post sales invoices create submit new sales invoice
description: Test the POST /sales/invoices/create/ endpoint with valid and invalid request bodies to verify creation of sales invoices and validation error handling.

title: post sales invoices id post post invoice and create accounting entry
description: Test the POST /sales/invoices/{id}/post/ endpoint to verify that posting an invoice creates the corresponding accounting entry and redirects correctly.
